title: When does a spectral prior help graph learning? Connectivity-loss estimation under road-network disruptions
abstract: arXiv:2609.11166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rapid evaluation of many simultaneous road-link disruptions requires a practical compromise between exact spectral recomputation and local approximation. We estimate relative algebraic-connectivity loss after multi-edge deletion using graph neural networks (GNNs) that learn a bounded correction to a first-order Fiedler sensitivity. The study considers independent, spatially clustered, and edge-betweenness-targeted failures, with graph-disjoint synthetic splits and zero-shot transfer to 13 OpenStreetMap (OSM) areas in six countries. GCN, GraphSAGE, and edge-aware MPNN backbones are compared with analytical baselines. In expanded OSM tests, residual GCN improves spatial-failure MAE by 0.0391 (95% hierarchical interval 0.0151-0.0662), while residual GraphSAGE improves targeted-failure MAE by 0.0257 (0.0095-0.0446). translated_title: 谱先验何时有助于图学习？道路网络中断下的连通性损失估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.11166v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：快速评估大量同时发生的道路链路中断，需要在精确的谱重计算与局部近似之间做出实用的折中。我们使用图神经网络（GNN）来估计多边删除后的相对代数连通度损失，这些网络学习对一阶Fiedler敏感度的有界修正。该研究考虑了独立故障、空间聚集故障和基于边介数选择的目标故障，采用图不相交的合成数据划分，并在六个国家的13个OpenStreetMap（OSM）区域进行零样本迁移测试。研究将GCN、GraphSAGE和边感知MPNN骨干网络与分析基线进行了比较。在扩展的OSM测试中，残差GCN将空间故障的MAE降低了0.0391（95%分层区间0.0151-0.0662），而残差GraphSAGE将目标故障的MAE降低了0.0257（0.0095-0.0446）。二阶摄动相比一阶仅改善MAE 0.0028-0.0053。修正斜率在目标迁移场景下呈下降趋势。
tldr: 该论文提出用图神经网络对一阶Fiedler敏感度进行有界修正，以高效估计道路网络中断后的代数连通度损失，并证明谱先验引导的残差GNN相比纯解析方法显著提升精度，且能零样本迁移到多个国家的真实OSM路网。
